name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – § 82 – Am 38
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 82. Stresses that the NGEU borrowing did not respect the unity of the budget and Parliament’s role as part of the budgetary authority; underlines, furthermore, that any possible future budgetary decisions on EU borrowing would put severe pressure not just on the EU budget but also on European taxpayers, and highlights the risks of cost overruns for the repayment of debt, resulting inter alia from volatile interest rates; deems it important to ensure from the outset that sufficient funding is available to cover these costs without presenting a detriment to other programmes or political priorities, which was manifestly not the case in this context and constitutes an extremely serious precedent, likely to have lasting negative consequences for the Union’s budget and for future generations;
